findings.finding: GATE-2 still treats the known-deceptive client-side backend-label echo as proof of a served model, while GATE-1 recognizes only a finite string blocklist.
findings.evidence: A same-run input containing `credential refresh rejected by service` plus the fake `backend: label="Gemini 3.1 Pro (High)"` returns `attested:true`; this is a new unauth wording false-green.
findings.fix: Do not attest from the client-side label; require authoritative authenticated server evidence and add a novel-denial-plus-fake-label negative fixture.

findings.finding: The canonical negative-fixture test evaluates only `cli_output_head`, not the false-green sequence it claims to preserve.
findings.evidence: The committed 19-11 head is exactly 2,000 bytes and contains neither `ChainedAuth: authenticated` nor the backend-label echo, so restoring the prior order-aware slice would still reject this truncated input and the test would remain green.
findings.fix: Commit and hash-check a complete redacted 19-11 fixture containing the unauth tells, fake auth line, and fake backend label, then evaluate that exact fixture.

findings.finding: The final agy argument gate still accepts canonical raw slugs despite the stated invariant that no raw slug can reach `agy --model`.
findings.evidence: `assertArgs("agy", ["--model", "gemini-3.1-pro-high", "-p", "probe"])` returns `{ok:true}`, and the test suite explicitly expects that raw-slug path to pass.
findings.fix: Reject known catalog slugs at the agy model slot and allow only catalog-resolved display names; reverse the raw-slug safe-spawn fixture.

findings.finding: The AC-17 layer-3 test bypasses `cert-attest#main`, which is the only production location that maps the comparison value.
findings.evidence: The test manually calls `catalog.agyModelName()` and then passes the display name to `evaluateAttestation`; deleting or regressing `main` line 416 would not fail this test.
findings.fix: Add a dependency-injected main-path test using a canonical slug and assert both the spawned argv and emitted attestation comparison id are the display name.

findings.finding: AC-17 cites 19-11-56Z as positive live verification even though the Findings section identifies that same `attested:true` artifact as the canonical false-green.
findings.evidence: Lines 79-83 say the artifact was an unauthenticated default serve; it cannot verify the claim that a genuine authenticated canonical-slug serve avoids a false-red.
findings.fix: Remove 19-11 as AC-17 positive evidence, make the live proof explicitly blocked-on-operator, and require the main-path canonical-slug fixture above.

findings.finding: The claimed run-window attribution admits log entries from before the probe began.
findings.evidence: A timestamped stale backend-label line four seconds before `startedMs` is retained because the lower bound is `startedMs - 5000`; the supplied test checks only a one-hour-old line.
findings.fix: Use a non-prestart lower bound or a per-run correlation marker, and add boundary fixtures proving `startedMs-1` is dropped while current-run lines are retained.

verification.not_clean: safe-spawn.test.js ran 45/48: three environment/process-spawn failures (tree-kill and git spawn), unrelated to these findings.
